name: Tool name carrying an out-of-charset homoglyph the confusable table cannot fold
notes: `ԝrite_file` begins with Armenian small letter co (U+051D), a look-alike for Latin `w` that is NOT in the guard's scoped Cyrillic/Greek confusable table — so canonicalization alone does not map it onto `write_file`. SEP-986 restricts tool names to [A-Za-z0-9._-], and all 863 tool names surveyed across 53 real public and hosted MCP servers conform, so a charset check closes the whole out-of-table homoglyph and invisible-character class on this carrier with no measured false positive. A tool's `name` was previously not an inspected carrier at all.
